checks.detail: Matched response means, every response benefit, and block gains/losses are retained. Mixed subgroup signs are reported; no aggregate-to-subgroup inference.
checks.name: Simpson's paradox

checks.detail: Fixed response/block results do not imply individual requests, populations, or serving gains. Anchors overlap and are not independent observations.
checks.name: Ecological fallacy

checks.detail: No estimated association or selected-sample correlation. Fixed TRAIN selection limits external validity and is disclosed.
checks.name: Berkson's paradox

checks.detail: No regression adjustment or conditioning on post-treatment covariates; roles are frozen at the common parent.
checks.name: Collider bias

checks.detail: Raw repair/follower counts accompany original opportunity totals; no diagnostic accuracy or population predictive probability is claimed.
checks.name: Base rate neglect

checks.detail: F and native C are matched one-step interventions from the same fixed warm parent. Selection is fixed; no selected-extreme cohort efficacy inference.
checks.name: Regression to the mean

checks.detail: All four planned cases, all selected endpoint readouts, every reserved call and attempt are audited. C_REPEAT is an integrity check, not an independent replicate.
checks.name: Survivorship bias

checks.detail: F-C is primary, F-BETA secondary, C-BETA derived context. All fixed contrasts and native-point probes are retained; no p-values or selective significance claims.
checks.name: Look-elsewhere effect

checks.detail: The fixed handoff, contract, source commit and ledger constrain this local diagnostic. Historical development selection prevents a confirmatory population interpretation.
checks.name: Garden of forking paths

checks.detail: Controlled local endpoint differences support only this exact intervention/window. A discrepancy does not uniquely explain the preceding 128-update serving result.
checks.name: Correlation versus causation

checks.detail: Frozen coefficients precede independently restored one-step endpoints; no cross-sectional directional association is estimated.
checks.name: Reverse causality
